audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for water at Rephidim/Massah/Meribah, staff/rock, Amalek attack, raised hands, altar YHWH-nissi.

verses.restored: All congregation of children of Israel journeyed from wilderness of Sin by their stages according to mouth of YHWH, and camped at Rephidim; and there was no water for the people to drink.

familiar.text: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the LORD, and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.

verses.restored: The people quarreled with Moses and said, Give us water so we may drink. Moses said to them, Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test YHWH?

familiar.text: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the LORD?

verses.restored: The people thirsted there for water, and the people grumbled against Moses and said, Why is this, that you brought us up from Egypt to kill me and my children and my livestock with thirst?

familiar.text: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?

verses.restored: Moses cried to YHWH, saying, What shall I do for this people? A little more and they will stone me.

familiar.text: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Pass before the people and take with you some elders of Israel; and your staff with which you struck the Nile, take in your hand and go.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.

verses.restored: Look, I will stand before you there on the rock at Horeb. You shall strike the rock, and water will come out from it, and the people will drink. Moses did so before eyes of elders of Israel.

familiar.text: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

verses.restored: He called name of the place Massah and Meribah because of quarrel of children of Israel and because they tested YHWH, saying, Is YHWH in our midst or not?

familiar.text: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD, saying, Is the LORD among us, or not?

verses.restored: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel at Rephidim.

familiar.text: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

verses.restored: Moses said to Joshua, Choose men for us and go out, fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on top of hill with staff of Divine in my hand.

familiar.text: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.

verses.restored: Joshua did as Moses said to him, to fight with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up top of hill.

familiar.text: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

verses.restored: It happened when Moses lifted his hand, Israel prevailed; and when he rested his hand, Amalek prevailed.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

verses.restored: Hands of Moses were heavy, so they took a stone and placed under him, and he sat on it; Aaron and Hur supported his hands, one from this side and one from that side, and his hands were steady until sun came.

familiar.text: But Moses’ hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.

verses.restored: Joshua weakened Amalek and his people by mouth of sword.

familiar.text: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Write this as memorial in the scroll and put in ears of Joshua: I will surely wipe out memory of Amalek from under heavens.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.

verses.restored: Moses built altar and called its name YHWH-nissi / YHWH is my banner.

familiar.text: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovahnissi:

verses.restored: He said, Because hand is upon throne/banner of Yah: war for YHWH against Amalek from generation to generation.

familiar.text: For he said, Because the LORD hath sworn that the LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.

translation_notes: Water crisis is real survival fear; do not trivialize Israel's question.
Massah/Meribah name the testing/quarreling memory: Is YHWH among us or not?
Moses' heavy hands require communal support from Aaron and Hur; leadership is not solitary performance.
Amalek material is severe and requires later ethical/reception-history audit.
safety_note: Amalek texts have dangerous reception history. Do not apply Amalek to modern ethnic, religious, or political groups. Here it is preserved as ancient attack-on-the-vulnerable memory and source material requiring careful audit.
